_help: User rules: original sentence in 'text' + structured 'rules'. target: { items: [ids] } | { groups: [names] } | { tags: [...] } | { all: true, except: { groups: [...] } }. rule types: onFloor, upright, noRotate, noLoadOnTop, maxLoadOnTop {kg}, maxHeight {cm | belowRoofCm}, zone {end: cab|door, withinCm}, loadGroup {n} (1 = loaded first, cab end), exclude, flex, optional (packed after all must-have items, dropped first). 'hard': false makes a zone a preference instead of a must.

constraints.text: Boxes go last: fit the non-box items first, then fill the rest with boxes and bags. Boxes are the first thing we take out if there isn't enough space.
We should start with the large items on the side.
constraints.note: on again 2026-10-29: user wants the large pieces in first because it makes sense to pack small things on top; no fixed order among them (not vitrine-then-bed); 'on the side' (along the walls) is not a rule type, only the loading order

constraints.text: Practical check of the plan (Claude, 2026-10-29): everything is lifted in by hand, so nothing above 175 cm (the headboard, 181 cm tall on its edge, is the only exception).
constraints.note: without it the plan stacks chairs, boxes and monitors to 190-209 cm of the 210 cm roof; switch off if you disagree
